This data set contains fifty-seven (57) registered scans of Edward Feuz's Chalet at the Swiss Edelweiss Village, Golden. This is cropped and cleaned data set. There were seventeen (17) exterior scans, collected with the Z+F 5010X scanner and registered with Laser Scout. There were forty (40) interior scans, collected with the Leica BLK 360 scanner and registered with Cyclone Register 360 (BLK edition). The exterior and interior scans were registered and processed in Autodesk Recap Pro V. 22.1. All data was collected by the Capture2Presev team on 14th May, 2022.
